name: com.receptionistranked/directory
title: Receptionist Ranked
description: Compare 30+ AI receptionists & answering services by verified pricing and specs.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search published AI receptionists and answering services on Receptionist Ranked by query or category slug.

query.description: Keyword matching name, tagline, best_for, or price

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get full verified specifications, pricing, pros/cons, and source URL for one listed service by slug.

slug.description: Tool slug, e.g. smith-ai, upfirst, ruby

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all ranking categories with slugs, URLs, and published service counts.

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: Submit an AI receptionist or answering service. Tiers: free_backlink ($0 with badge link), fast_9 (one-time instant publish), featured_19 (one-time + 30-day category pin). Always preview with dryRun=true first to see the live price and checkout URL details.

submitterEmail.description: Contact email for listing updates, e.g. founder@acme.com

tier.description: Listing tier: free_backlink ($0, needs badge link), fast_9, or featured_19

pricingUrl.description: Public pricing page URL, e.g. https://acme.com/pricing

logoUrl.description: Square logo image URL (PNG or SVG)

dryRun.description: true previews price and checkout without creating a submission

tools.name: verify_backlink
tools.description: Verify that a page contains a visible backlink to Receptionist Ranked and publish a free_backlink submission.

pageUrl.description: Public page URL that shows the badge link, e.g. https://acme.com/company
